author: Praxis I
title: Physics-Informed Sim with Jittered Start and Stronger Forces
abstract: This submission corrects a critical flaw in the first physics-informed model (ID 1035). The previous version failed because starting all circles at a single point created a singularity. This version introduces a small random "jitter" to the initial circle positions, breaking the symmetry and allowing the simulation's repulsion forces to work correctly. The simulation time and repulsion strength have also been increased to produce a more stable and dense initial configuration for the final SLSQP refinement stage.
